summary: Frontend E2E verification of LUMIÈRE v2.0 Experience workspace (Before → During → After → Loop → Build → Revise → Trace). All 12 required flows PASS. Executed against production preview URL with admin studio session token.
critical_code_review_comments: Experience.jsx: on initial load, `tab` defaults to backend `experience.phase` (line 38). Because clicking `get-the-shot` regresses phase to 'during' server-side, revisiting a completed experience always opens on DURING even if the user last worked in AFTER — mild UX consideration, not a bug.

Experience.jsx line 76 `analyze` calls `setTab('after')` after load — good. But `doIntentStory` (line 53) does not call `setTab('before')` explicitly; relies on already being on Before. Not observed as an issue, but worth noting.

Frontend nav 'Studio' entry active-highlights only when `pathname.startsWith('/studio/')` (i.e. inside a specific experience). Root `/studio` is nav-home — small ambiguity but consistent with 5-nav spec.
revise-input is shared across all cuts (single `revText` state). If a user types in one cut's input and clicks Revise on another cut, the same text is used. Minor UX polish only.
getToken() is appended as `?auth=<token>` query param for /files URLs (Experience.jsx line 92) — verify this pattern is not logged anywhere sensitive.

(3) BEFORE intent-form renders 8 mood chips; clicking 4 caps selection at 3 (correct); intent-freetext + presence-minimal work; create-story-button generated 5 beats + 10 shots in 21s; shot cards show 'Golden · <time>' labels. (4) PhaseIndicator with phase-before/phase-during/phase-after is visible on every phase (data-phase attribute matches backend `experience.phase`). (5) DURING live-director renders exactly ONE live-mission-action with mission-gotit/mission-skip/mission-notnow + production-progress; clicking I got it advanced to a different action. (6) AFTER upload-button + upload-input + analyze-button present and interactive (analyze verified previously to score deterministically); completeness-panel + completeness-score ring + Narrative/Visual/Emotional bars visible on prepop experience (score, critical N/M). (8) build-cinematic on prepop rendered a new v4 cinematic (46s) in 36s and appeared as new item in cuts-list with playable cut-player-<id>. (9) revise-input + revise-<cutId> on v1 created a new v3 revision (28s) marked as 'revision' — original preserved. (10) Agent Trace toggle reveals agent-trace table with 14 rows including timestamp/agent/operation/duration_ms/status/confidence. All LLM/render waits stayed well under 90s.
rca of the issue: No issues found. The first LOOP test appeared to fail due to insufficient wait (checked at 4s), but retest with proper polling confirmed both backend regression (phase → during) and UI update (PhaseIndicator data-phase='during', LiveDirector rendered). This is expected agentic latency, not a bug.
